about: COV-TIME u2 (feat/cov-time-u2): FRED's capmatrix C1-C9 admission gaps. C3 ONE date-string reader (clockFns.dateStringMs) for the input.time default, the runtime bare call and the host-lane fold: month-first, GMT+N east, no zone GMT+0 (vw-cap-c3-timestamp-{a..e}-spy-{1d,15}-2026-11-26); C2 timeframe.change("3M"|"12M") = ta.change(time(tf)) != 0 (vw-cap-c2-change-qy-spy-{1d,1w,1m}); C9 bars_back = the call N chart bars back, time_close("") = time_close (vw-cap-c9-time-close-bars-back-spy-1d); C1 in_seconds n x unit (vw-cap-c1-from-seconds-spy-1d). Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.
